stories: A deer crashed into a laundromat, ran across the washing machines, then escaped through the window it broke.
Police in Virginia chased a runaway sheep through a neighborhood. Now they are hunting for its owner.
A man rode a motorcycle more than 25 miles down a river. On top of the water.
